_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/accordion/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 300x420. Root is a column with padding 10 and gap 10, children not stretched: m is size [280,150] -> 10,10,280,150; s is size [280,90] -> 10, 10+150+10=170, 280,90. Only the two explicit sizes and the root are pinned: a header's height is padding + one text line, i.e. a font metric, so the panels' y values are reported by the probe but deliberately not stated here.
points: (5,5) is inside the root's 10px padding -> the root's own white.
(5,165) is in the 10px gap between m (ends at y=160) and s (starts at y=170) -> white.
(150,300) is below s (which ends at y=260) and inside the root -> white.
_derivation.not_pinned: The header fills (#DBEAFE open / #F3F4F6 closed) are sampled in Main.as at each header's own midpoint, because their y is a font metric; what makes them a contract is that the probe samples THREE headers of a multi accordion with two open, so any implementation that fills one index (the first, or the last) fails. Everything else -- which panels are mounted, the order-insensitive [2,0] set, the canonical ascending write-back, the onToggle index, and the four refused option combinations -- is program state and is reported through <OUT>.done.
